status_definitions.authored_unreviewed: The whole stated bounded reader extent is evidenced by actual current text and, where needed, matched complete author/source-extent records and supplied proof components. This is writing status only, not independent source/proof or publication admission.
status_definitions.partial: A substantive current treatment or explicit authoring package is evidenced, but a specifically named required component, full source-specific presentation, proof construction, comparison or integration link remains absent or unestablished; exact residuals are listed.
status_definitions.missing: The allocated presentation has no current identified reader treatment after the scoped route/source checks; exact absent components and the evidence boundary are specified. A missing catalogue path alone does not suffice.
status_definitions.unassessed: Available inspected evidence does not settle whole required coverage. Includes located but unread/unassessed full bodies and planned scopes without a precise current reader interval. It does not imply missing or unwritten.

source_facet_join_standing: Existing canonical identities only. Subject/source allocations follow preserved component titles and the P1–P3 placement note.
